castors-01-alex-s-treasure:
Alex the explorer has found an old treasure map! The map is a grid where each square contains a symbol:

Starting Point Grass Mountain Water Treasure

 

Alex is at the starting point and wants to reach the treasure, but she must follow three rules:

  1. She cannot step on water.
  2. She must cross at least one mountain.
  3. She can move up (↑), down (↓), left (←), or right (→),  but not diagonally ( / , \ ).

Question
Which path can she take to follow the rules?
castors-02-beautiful-drawings:
Lars has drawn some plants. His baby sister, Carlotta, found these drawings and tried to make them more beautiful with finger paint. Match the original images with those that Carlotta has drawn over. 

Task
Drag each original drawing to sit below its new version.

castors-07-robot-rug:
Sarah has a knitting robot that makes rugs using four different patterns. Each pattern has a two digit code:

00
11
01
10


Sarah writes a set of instructions for the robot. Each code tells the robot which pattern to knit. The robot knits row by row, from left to right, top to bottom.

00-10-10-10-01-10-10-10-00

10-01-10-01-01-01-10-01-10

01-11-01-01-11-01-01-11-01

10-01-10-01-01-01-10-01-10

00-10-10-10-01-10-10-10-00

Question
Which rug will the robot make using Sarah's program?
